rows.geography: St Martin in the Fields, Westminster, London, England
rows.population_boundary: workhouse admission episodes, including repeat admissions
rows.uncertainty: Missing literal discharge dates and same-day discharges share a zero browse-index span; the deterministic audit found 33 missing dates and 17 same-day dates in 50 sampled zero spans.
rows.interpretation: coverage count, not a population stock
rows.target_compatibility: local institutional episode; not a Great Britain paid-employment flow or hire-available nonemployment spell

rows.geography: St Martin in the Fields, Westminster, London, England
rows.population_boundary: workhouse admission episodes, including repeat admissions
rows.numerator: sum of nonnegative API before-minus-after indexes
rows.denominator: episodes with a nonnegative indexable pair
rows.uncertainty: Missing literal discharge dates and same-day discharges share a zero browse-index span; the deterministic audit found 33 missing dates and 17 same-day dates in 50 sampled zero spans.
rows.interpretation: index statistic; ambiguous zero spans are included
rows.target_compatibility: local institutional episode; not a Great Britain paid-employment flow or hire-available nonemployment spell

rows.metric_label: Lower bound on mean episode duration
rows.geography: St Martin in the Fields, Westminster, London, England
rows.population_boundary: workhouse admission episodes, including repeat admissions
rows.numerator: sum of strictly positive indexed spans; all ambiguous or missing durations assigned zero
rows.uncertainty: upper bound is unavailable because blank discharge dates are right-censored or unresolved; Missing literal discharge dates and same-day discharges share a zero browse-index span; the deterministic audit found 33 missing dates and 17 same-day dates in 50 sampled zero spans.
rows.interpretation: mathematical lower bound only, not an estimated mean
rows.target_compatibility: local institutional episode; not a Great Britain paid-employment flow or hire-available nonemployment spell

rows.geography: St Luke Chelsea parish, Middlesex/London, England
rows.population_boundary: workhouse admission episodes, including repeat admissions
rows.uncertainty: literal exit date is missing for 36 records; free-text destinations are conservatively classified; repeat persons are not linked
rows.interpretation: coverage count, not a population stock
rows.target_compatibility: local institutional episode; not a Great Britain paid-employment flow or hire-available nonemployment spell

rows.metric_label: Mean duration among episodes with both dates
rows.geography: St Luke Chelsea parish, Middlesex/London, England
rows.population_boundary: workhouse admission episodes, including repeat admissions
rows.denominator: episodes with valid admission and exit dates
rows.uncertainty: literal exit date is missing for 36 records; free-text destinations are conservatively classified; repeat persons are not linked
rows.target_compatibility: local institutional episode; not a Great Britain paid-employment flow or hire-available nonemployment spell

rows.metric_label: Lower bound on mean episode duration
rows.geography: St Luke Chelsea parish, Middlesex/London, England
rows.population_boundary: workhouse admission episodes, including repeat admissions
rows.numerator: sum of observed nonnegative elapsed days; missing durations assigned zero
rows.uncertainty: upper bound is unavailable; literal exit date is missing for 36 records; free-text destinations are conservatively classified; repeat persons are not linked
rows.interpretation: mathematical lower bound only, not an estimated mean
rows.target_compatibility: local institutional episode; not a Great Britain paid-employment flow or hire-available nonemployment spell

rows.metric_label: Share with an explicit work or service destination
rows.geography: St Luke Chelsea parish, Middlesex/London, England
rows.population_boundary: workhouse admission episodes, including repeat admissions
rows.numerator: records whose exit wording explicitly states work, service, hire or a place
rows.uncertainty: literal exit date is missing for 36 records; free-text destinations are conservatively classified; repeat persons are not linked; unclassified reasons may include additional placements
rows.interpretation: recorded-destination share, not an employment-entry probability
rows.target_compatibility: local institutional episode; not a Great Britain paid-employment flow or hire-available nonemployment spell

rows.metric_label: Lower bound on pre-placement institutional duration
rows.geography: St Luke Chelsea parish, Middlesex/London, England
rows.population_boundary: episodes with an explicit work or service destination
rows.numerator: sum of observed nonnegative elapsed days; missing durations assigned zero
rows.denominator: all explicit work or service destination records
rows.uncertainty: upper bound is unavailable; destination wording does not prove paid status
rows.interpretation: selected successful recorded exits from an institution
rows.target_compatibility: local institutional episode; not a Great Britain paid-employment flow or hire-available nonemployment spell

rows.metric_label: Record-weighted lower bound across the two extracted workhouse datasets
rows.geography: two London-area parishes: St Martin in the Fields and St Luke Chelsea
rows.period: 1770-1819 with St Luke observed only in 1782-1799
rows.population_boundary: union of extracted workhouse admission records, not persons or residents
rows.numerator: sum of strictly positive observed/indexed durations in both datasets
rows.denominator: all records in both extracted datasets
rows.uncertainty: upper bound unavailable; source coverage, periods and censoring differ; St Martin dominates the record count
rows.interpretation: descriptive record-union bound only; it is not a parish, London or Great Britain average
rows.target_compatibility: local institutional episode; not a Great Britain paid-employment flow or hire-available nonemployment spell

rows.metric_label: East India Company annual salary records
rows.geography: East India Company home establishment, London, England
rows.population_boundary: annual home-establishment salary records with parsed person identifiers
rows.uncertainty: all retrieved rows passed the year-specific person-ID parser; identifiers and names inherit the source transcription
rows.target_compatibility: one-employer annual roster; not a paid-employment/nonemployment flow

rows.metric_label: Weighted share absent from the next annual roster
rows.geography: East India Company home establishment, London, England
rows.population_boundary: identifiable persons in annual salary records
rows.numerator: employee IDs present in year t and absent in t+1, summed across boundaries
rows.denominator: employee IDs present in each opening roster, summed across boundaries
rows.uncertainty: annual roster absence does not separate missing records, transfers, retirement, death, migration or employment elsewhere
rows.interpretation: annual employer-roster disappearance, not an exit hazard
rows.target_compatibility: wrong destination, time unit, population and geography for the target

rows.metric_label: Weighted share absent from the prior annual roster
rows.geography: East India Company home establishment, London, England
rows.population_boundary: identifiable persons in annual salary records
rows.numerator: employee IDs present in year t and absent in t-1, summed across boundaries
rows.denominator: employee IDs present in each current roster, summed across boundaries
rows.uncertainty: annual roster absence does not separate missing records, transfers, retirement, death, migration or employment elsewhere
rows.interpretation: annual new-to-roster share, not entry from nonemployment
rows.target_compatibility: wrong origin, time unit, population and geography for the target

rows.geography: Marine Society recruitment, centered on London, England
rows.population_boundary: boys in the London Lives socioeconomic recruitment sample
rows.uncertainty: approximately 14 percent systematic sample in selected periods; prior hire availability and subsequent paid status are not observed
rows.target_compatibility: selected recruitment event without an opening hire-available denominator

rows.metric_label: Mean age in the public recruitment sample
rows.geography: Marine Society recruitment, centered on London, England
rows.population_boundary: boys in the London Lives socioeconomic recruitment sample
rows.uncertainty: approximately 14 percent systematic sample in selected periods; prior hire availability and subsequent paid status are not observed
rows.interpretation: sample composition, not a labor-flow parameter
rows.target_compatibility: not compatible with any Phase 6J target estimand
